verdict.rationale: Qodo documents an official Agentic Toolbox CLI for using Qodo-managed skills locally, including reviewing changes before opening a pull request and retrieving the rules and standards that apply to a task; a probe confirmed the CLI docs page exists. A community user also reports hands-on use of the 'Qodo Command CLI' with process permission toggles. Missing for 10: detailed command reference, installation and authentication evidence, and depth beyond brief doc snippets.
